_readme: To add a job, paste a new object into the 'jobs' array. 'id' must be a unique slug (lowercase, hyphens). Dates use YYYY-MM-DD and lastDate is optional. The company logo is picked up automatically from the apply link; see README.md for the optional 'website' and 'logo' fields.

jobs.eligibility: Graduates with proven working experience as a Data Analyst or Business Data Analyst; very good English (B2/C1 level)
jobs.experience: Proven experience required (exact years not stated)
jobs.summary: PerkinElmer is hiring a OneSource Data Analyst in India. SQL, ETL, reporting and Power BI skills needed; proven data analyst experience required.
description: PerkinElmer is hiring a OneSource Data Analyst (job ID REQ-058949) in India. The job is a regular, full-time position. The company wants a data analyst who can make sure customer and PerkinElmer data is complete, accurate and easy to access. The posting does not name a city or the exact years of experience, so check these on the official page before you apply.

As a Data Analyst you will work with other data professionals to extract data, build reports from your findings and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to judge whether business initiatives are working. You will interpret data with statistical techniques, collect data from primary and secondary sources, maintain databases and data systems, find trends and patterns in complex data sets, and clean data by checking reports and correcting code problems. You will also work with management to set priorities and look for ways to improve processes.

The basic requirements are knowledge of data models, data mining, segmentation and data cleaning, experience with reporting tools, databases (SQL) and ETL frameworks, strong analytical skills and very good English at B2/C1 level. The company prefers candidates with proven experience as a Data Analyst or Business Data Analyst, experience with Power BI or similar visualisation software, SAP or other ERP systems, and previous work in a service organisation. This is not a fresher role, but it is a good target if you are building SQL, Power BI and ETL skills.
responsibilities: Interpret data, analyse results using statistical techniques and provide ongoing reports.
Use data collection systems, analytics and other methods that improve statistical efficiency and quality.
Acquire data from primary or secondary sources and maintain databases and data systems.
Identify, analyse and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets.
Filter and clean data by reviewing reports and performance indicators, and correct code problems.
Work with management to prioritise business and information needs.
Find and define new process improvement opportunities.
requirements: Technical knowledge of data models, data mining, segmentation techniques and data cleaning.
Experience with reporting packages, databases (SQL etc.) and ETL frameworks.
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail and accuracy.
Skilled at queries, report writing and presenting findings.
Very good English, minimum B2/C1 level (written and spoken).
Preferred: proven experience as a Data Analyst or Business Data Analyst, Power BI, SAP or similar ERP, ETL tools, and service organisation experience.
jobs.aboutCompany: PerkinElmer is a global company in the life sciences and diagnostics industry. This role supports its OneSource data work, which keeps customer and company data complete, accurate and accessible.

jobs.eligibility: Graduates in any field (B.Tech, B.E., B.Sc, B.Com, BCA, BBA, M.Sc, MBA or similar) passing out in 2024, 2025 or 2026
jobs.summary: SphinxHire is hiring a Data Analyst (Fresher) in Hyderabad. 2024-2026 graduates of any stream can apply. Salary 8 LPA, work from office. SQL and Excel needed.
description: SphinxHire, an AI recruitment company based in Hyderabad, is hiring a Data Analyst (Fresher) for its full-time, work-from-office team. The company builds an applicant tracking system that helps employers post jobs, screen applicants with AI and hire faster. The role offers a salary of 8 LPA and is open to graduates from 2024, 2025 and 2026 batches.

In this role you will work with the founders, product and sales teams to turn hiring data into clear answers, such as which jobs attract the best candidates, how long hiring takes, where applicants come from and how well the AI screening works. Day to day, you will collect and clean data, write SQL queries, build reports and dashboards in Excel, Google Sheets, Looker Studio or Power BI, track key hiring numbers and prepare weekly and monthly reports for the leadership team.

Graduates from any field can apply. You need good working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, basic SQL (SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY and JOINs), basic statistics and clear English. Python, Power BI or Tableau, and a data project or Kaggle notebook are good to have but not required. The company promises structured training in SQL, dashboards and AI tools for the first three months, direct mentoring from the founders and a path to Senior Data Analyst.
responsibilities: Collect, clean and organise data from the hiring platform, job boards and internal tools.
Write SQL queries to answer questions from the product, sales and customer teams.
Build and maintain reports and dashboards in Excel, Google Sheets, Looker Studio or Power BI.
Track key hiring numbers such as applicants per job, time to hire, source of hire and offer acceptance.
Study how AI screening scores match real hiring outcomes and help improve them.
Spot trends and unusual patterns and explain them in plain language.
Prepare short weekly and monthly reports for the leadership team.
Help customers understand their hiring reports, and keep data accurate and documented.
requirements: Graduate in any field, passing out in 2024, 2025 or 2026.
Good working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets: formulas, pivot tables, VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP and charts.
Basic SQL: SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY and JOINs.
Basic understanding of statistics: averages, percentages, distributions and simple trends.
Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to explain numbers to non-technical people.
Good to have: Python (pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib), Power BI, Tableau or Looker Studio, and a data project or Kaggle notebook.
selectionProcess: Apply online and upload your resume; applications are screened by AI.
Shortlisted profiles are reviewed personally by the SphinxHire team.
jobs.aboutCompany: SphinxHire is an AI recruitment company in Hyderabad. Its applicant tracking system helps companies post jobs, screen every applicant with AI the moment they apply, and hire faster and more fairly.

jobs.batch: Freshers (0 years of experience); no backlogs at the time of the IBM selection process
jobs.eligibility: B.E/B.Tech in Electronics, Electronics & Communications or Information Technology; no active backlogs
jobs.location: Hyderabad, Pune, Gurugram, Chennai, Noida, Bengaluru and New Delhi
jobs.summary: IBM is hiring freshers (B.E/B.Tech, 0 years) as System Support Representative in Hyderabad, Pune, Gurugram, Chennai, Noida, Bengaluru and New Delhi. Hybrid, day shift.
description: IBM India is hiring a System Support Representative for its Infrastructure and Technology area, and the posting is open to freshers with 0 years of experience. The role is a regular, professional-level position with a general day shift, a hybrid work arrangement and no travel. Openings are listed for Hyderabad, Pune, Gurugram, Chennai, Noida, Bengaluru and New Delhi.

This is an individual contributor role focused on customers. You will be responsible for on-site installation, maintenance and repair of IBM and multi-vendor systems and components, including hardware, networking products, software and operating systems. You will be the main technical contact for customers, coordinating hardware and software support and delivering technical services. When a critical situation occurs, you act as the IBM technical contact and manage it until the problem is fixed.

Client satisfaction is the main goal of the job. You will work with clients, vendors and senior management to identify and resolve complex technical problems. The business unit is IBM Systems, which builds servers and storage for hybrid cloud and AI. Candidates should have a B.E/B.Tech degree in Electronics, Electronics & Communications or Information Technology and no backlogs when the IBM selection process takes place. IBM suggests applying to no more than 3 roles in a year, so apply only if this role matches your skills.
responsibilities: Install, maintain and repair IBM and multi-vendor hardware, networking products, software and operating systems at customer sites.
Act as the primary technical contact for customers and coordinate hardware and software support.
Deliver technical services as required by the customer.
Work with clients, vendors and senior management to resolve complex technical problems.
Manage critical situations as the IBM technical contact until the problem is fixed.
Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction with service delivery, technical support and operational services.
requirements: B.E/B.Tech degree in Electronics, Electronics & Communications or Information Technology.
No backlogs at the time of the IBM selection process.
0 years of experience (freshers can apply).
Good communication and customer handling skills.
Basic understanding of hardware, networking and operating systems.
jobs.aboutCompany: IBM is one of the largest technology and consulting employers in the world, founded in 1911. It builds open hybrid cloud and AI solutions for clients across industries, and IBM Systems develops servers and storage for hybrid cloud and AI.

jobs.eligibility: Any graduate (UG) with 5 to 10 years of experience in data engineering
jobs.summary: Genpact is hiring an AWS Data Engineer with 5-10 years of experience (PySpark, Python, SQL) in Delhi NCR, Bengaluru and Hyderabad. Hybrid work.
description: Genpact is hiring an AWS Data Engineer for its data and analytics work, with openings in Delhi NCR, Bengaluru and Hyderabad in a hybrid work model. The role is listed under IT Services and Consulting, in the Data Science and Analytics department, as a full-time, permanent position. The posting mentions 3 openings and asks for 5 to 10 years of experience, so it is aimed at experienced engineers and not at freshers.

The core of the job is building and improving data pipelines and integration frameworks. You will develop and optimise complex pipelines, reconcile data, build advanced transformations and tune performance. You will also design and run unit, integration and system tests, put CI/CD processes and engineering automation standards in place, and build monitoring, observability and alerting so that problems are caught early. Another part of the role is using cloud platforms in a cost-aware way, and troubleshooting complex production and performance issues.

The key skills named in the posting are AWS data engineering, PySpark, Python and SQL. Any graduate can apply as long as the experience requirement is met. If you are earlier in your career and want to reach this level, build a small end-to-end pipeline on AWS with PySpark, add tests and monitoring, and be ready to explain how you handled data quality and cost in your design.
responsibilities: Develop and optimise complex data pipelines and integration frameworks.
Perform data reconciliation, advanced transformation development and performance tuning.
Design and run unit, integration and system testing activities.
Implement CI/CD processes and engineering automation standards.
Build monitoring, observability and alerting capabilities.
Optimise platform usage through cloud cost-aware engineering practices.
Troubleshoot complex production and performance issues.
requirements: 5 to 10 years of experience in data engineering.
Hands-on experience with AWS data engineering services.
Strong skills in PySpark, Python and SQL.
Experience building and testing data pipelines, and implementing CI/CD.
Education: any graduate (UG).
jobs.aboutCompany: Genpact (NYSE: G) describes itself as an advanced technology services and solutions company that helps global enterprises with deep business knowledge, operational excellence and solutions built on data, technology and AI.

jobs.eligibility: Experience or knowledge of reward systems, compensation management and total rewards (exact years not stated by the company)
jobs.summary: HSBC is hiring an Executive Compensation Analyst for its Performance and Reward team in Hyderabad and Bengaluru (hybrid). Experienced hiring.
description: HSBC is hiring an Executive Compensation Analyst for its Performance and Reward team, with openings in Hyderabad and Bengaluru and a hybrid work style. The role supports executive compensation, reward processes and regulatory requirements for the relevant business entity. HSBC describes itself as one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. The posting is issued by HSBC Electronic Data Processing (India) Private Limited.

In this role you will support the Reward Manager with reward processes, including the annual pay review, and work with business stakeholders and HR generalists so that reward policies support business objectives. You will help review and change existing reward programmes, including the design of new ones, and prepare reward metrics, reports and communications for senior stakeholders, external consultancies and regulatory bodies. You will also execute the annual pay review cycle, make sure eligibility information is shared accurately, and ensure that local regulatory rules and internal policies are followed throughout.

Please note that this is experienced hiring, not a fresher opening, because HSBC says it is looking for an experienced professional. The application deadline shown in the posting was 23 November 2026, which has already passed, so check the official page to see whether the role is still open before you apply. If you want to move into reward or compensation roles, learn the basics of total rewards, incentive compensation and benefits, and practise building clear reports from compensation data.
responsibilities: Support the Reward Manager with reward processes, including the annual pay review.
Work with business stakeholders and HR generalists so reward policies support business objectives.
Support the review and change of existing reward programmes, including designing new programmes.
Produce reward metrics, reports and communications for senior stakeholders, consultancies and regulators.
Execute the annual pay review cycle and ensure eligibility information is shared accurately.
Ensure local regulatory rules and internal policies are followed in reward processes.
Support compensation analysis, performance reviews and reward programme monitoring.
Partner with stakeholders to deliver accurate, compliant and competitive reward outcomes.
requirements: Experience or knowledge of reward systems, compensation management and total rewards.
Knowledge of executive compensation, incentive compensation and benefits management.
Understanding of reward strategy and how it aligns with business strategy.
Strong reporting, data analysis and performance analysis skills.
Experience supporting payroll processing and annual pay review activities.
Knowledge of compliance requirements, government regulations and internal policies.
Ability to monitor performance and assess the effectiveness of reward programmes.
Strong organisational, interpersonal, problem-solving, verbal and written communication skills.
jobs.aboutCompany: HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, operating in 64 countries and territories. It states that it is an equal opportunity employer, considers applications on merit and suitability for the role, and supports continuous professional development and flexible working.

jobs.batch: Experienced hiring (1+ years, not a fresher role)
jobs.eligibility: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, with 1+ years in software and applied AI/ML engineering
jobs.summary: Apple is hiring a Software Engineer (AI) in Bengaluru to build GenAI and agentic data products. 1+ years of AI/ML engineering experience required.
description: Apple is hiring a Software Engineer focused on AI for its Bengaluru location. The role is part of Information Systems and Technology (IS&T), the organisation that builds and runs the enterprise and customer technology systems behind Apple's business and supports around 2.5 billion active Apple devices. Within IS&T, the AI & Data Platforms (AiDP) team brings together data, application development and machine learning, including generative AI, to help Apple build and adopt AI-powered solutions faster.

You would join the Enterprise Data Warehouse team, which works with petabytes of data across real-time, near real-time and batch pipelines, and builds data-centric agentic solutions on top of those assets. The work supports business areas such as Retail, Sales, Operations, Finance, AppleCare, Marketing and Internet Services. In this role you are expected to understand a business challenge, work with business and cross-functional teams, design a statistical or deep learning solution, build it yourself or guide another engineer, deliver it to production and keep good governance of your work.

Please note that this is not an entry-level fresher opening, because Apple asks for at least 1+ years of experience in software and applied AI/ML engineering. The core requirements are strong Python or Java skills, hands-on experience with GenAI applications such as RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases and semantic search, and practical experience building AI agents or agentic workflows with frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex. If you are a graduate aiming for roles like this, build a small end-to-end RAG or agent project and be ready to explain how it works, how you tested it and how you would run it reliably in production.
responsibilities: Understand business challenges and turn ambiguous problems into scalable technical designs.
Collaborate with business and other cross-functional teams.
Design statistical or deep learning solutions to answer business questions.
Develop solutions yourself or guide another person to build them.
Deliver solutions into production with attention to governance, reliability and observability.
Build data-centric agentic solutions on large enterprise data assets.
requirements: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, with 1+ years in software and applied AI/ML engineering.
Programming proficiency in Python or Java.
Experience building GenAI-powered applications, including RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases and semantic search over structured and unstructured data.
Practical experience building AI agents or agentic workflows (planning, memory, tool use, execution loops) with frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex.
Preferred: full-stack development across backend APIs, data services and front-end layers.
Preferred: multi-agent systems, and cloud platforms (AWS preferred, GCP or Azure) with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Preferred: front-end or app frameworks such as React, Streamlit or FastAPI, and enterprise domain experience in Retail, Finance, Sales, Marketing or Operations analytics.
jobs.aboutCompany: Apple's Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organisation builds the enterprise and customer technology systems behind Apple's products and services. Apple states that accessibility is a fundamental human right and says this is reflected in its culture, benefits and digital tools.

jobs.eligibility: Bachelor's degree with 5+ years of analytical experience in a US MNC, consulting or banking; overall performance rating of 5 or above in the last review
jobs.workMode: Hybrid | Evening shift, Mon-Fri 2:30 PM to 1:00 AM IST
jobs.summary: American Express is hiring an experienced Analyst for its Data Analytics team in Gurugram. 5+ years of analytics experience required; apply before 26 Nov 2026.
description: American Express is hiring an Analyst in its Data Analytics function for the Client Hierarchy Centre of Excellence (COE) in Gurugram. This team focuses on understanding what global commercial clients need, advising them and delivering accurate, compliant data. It works closely with clients, strategic partners and many internal teams, including client management, implementation, onboarding, account consultancy, servicing, new accounts, technology and operational excellence. The person in this role will help solve a major client pain point and drive the adoption of digital products with stronger data capabilities.

The job is analytics-heavy. You will analyse complex datasets to spot trends and insights, build dashboards and reports in tools such as Power BI, Tableau or Looker, and write clean SQL queries and Python or R scripts. You will also manage data-cleansing projects for commercial programs, resolve client queries about data, and review client relationships at obligor level, using external sources such as LexisNexis, D&B reports and Secretary of State records to verify legal entities.

Please note that this is an experienced-hire position, not a fresher opening. The working hours are Monday to Friday, 2:30 PM to 1:00 AM IST in a hybrid model. Freshers can still use this listing to understand what skills MNC analytics teams expect at the next career level.
responsibilities: Lead data-cleansing projects for commercial programs together with client managers, administrators and technology teams.
Resolve client data queries with a strong customer-first approach.
Analyse trends and flag opportunities for a better customer experience and more digitisation.
Verify legal entities using external data sources and public tools.
Build reports, dashboards and data visualisations, and present insights to client managers.
Support accurate calculation of incentives with internal stakeholders.
Deliver high-quality work on tight timelines with minimal supervision.
requirements: Graduate (Bachelor's degree) with 5+ years of analytical experience in a US MNC, consulting firm or bank.
Strong SQL and at least one programming language, with Python preferred.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Ability to explain complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Willingness to learn web-based database platforms, AS400 mainframe screens and MySQL-based tools.
Excellent verbal and written communication, and attention to detail.
Overall performance rating of 5 or above in the last review.
jobs.aboutCompany: American Express describes a 175-year history of innovation and a strong focus on trust, security and service. Benefits listed in the posting include competitive salaries, bonus incentives, medical and insurance cover (depending on location), flexible hybrid working, paid parental leave, wellness support, counselling through its Healthy Minds programme and career development. An offer is subject to a successful background verification.

jobs.batch: Freshers and up to 2 years experience
jobs.eligibility: 15 years of full-time education (as stated by Accenture)
jobs.summary: Accenture is hiring a Technology Architecture Associate (0-2 years) in Bengaluru with Azure Stack as the must-have skill.
description: Accenture is hiring a Technology Architect at the Technology Architecture Associate level for its Bengaluru office. The role suits candidates with 0 to 2 years of experience. A Technology Architect designs and delivers the technology architecture for a platform, product or client engagement, and defines solutions that meet performance, capability and scalability needs. The main requirement is proficiency in Azure Stack, and knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server administration and Linux is a good addition.

In this position you are expected to build your knowledge, support the team and take part in problem-solving discussions. You will work with cross-functional teams to collect requirements and turn them into architectural solutions, help document designs and technical standards, and contribute ideas that make the architecture more efficient. As you gain experience you will also guide junior colleagues on architectural best practices.

The posting expects a good understanding of cloud infrastructure and hybrid cloud environments, the ability to analyse requirements and design scalable and secure architectures, familiarity with deploying and managing cloud-based solutions, and experience in troubleshooting and optimising technology platforms. If you are a fresher, a good way to prepare is to build a small hands-on lab with Azure or a hybrid setup and be ready to explain what you built and why.
responsibilities: Build knowledge and support the team in delivering architecture work.
Take part in problem-solving discussions.
Gather requirements with cross-functional teams and translate them into architectural solutions.
Help document architecture designs and maintain technical standards.
Suggest improvements that increase architecture efficiency.
Support junior team members with guidance on best practices.
requirements: Proficiency in Azure Stack (must have).
Experience with Linux and Microsoft Windows Server administration (good to have).
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure and hybrid cloud environments.
Ability to analyse system requirements and design scalable, secure architectures.
Familiarity with deploying and managing cloud-based solutions.
15 years of full-time education.
jobs.aboutCompany: Accenture is a global technology and consulting company that says it has more than 775,000 people worldwide. It states that no one is ever required to pay for employment at Accenture. If anyone asks you for money, do not respond and report it to india.fc.check@accenture.com.

jobs.summary: HCLTech is hiring fresh graduates for Python-based software development roles in Bhubaneswar under its Campus Beginner programme.
description: HCLTech is looking for enthusiastic and motivated fresh graduates who have a passion for programming and software development. Selected candidates will work with experienced engineering teams to develop, test and maintain Python-based applications. Along the way they will get exposure to modern software development practices, automation, AI and cloud technologies. The opening is listed under the Campus Beginner category and the work location is Bhubaneswar, Odisha.

On the job you will write and maintain Python applications and scripts, follow coding standards, and debug issues with guidance from senior developers. You will take part in code reviews and team discussions, work with databases to store and retrieve application data, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements. You will also support automation, data processing and application enhancement work, and keep learning new technologies and best practices.

The posting does not list a salary, batch or detailed skill criteria on the page we reviewed, so check the official HCLTech page before you apply. To prepare, revise Python fundamentals such as data structures, functions and file handling, practise basic SQL, and keep one or two small Python projects ready to explain in an interview.
responsibilities: Develop, test and maintain Python applications and scripts.
Write clean, efficient and reusable code that follows coding standards.
Debug and troubleshoot software issues with guidance from senior developers.
Take part in code reviews and team discussions.
Work with databases to store and retrieve application data.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements.
Support automation, data processing and application enhancement activities.
Keep learning new technologies and best practices.
requirements: Fresh graduate with a passion for programming and software development.
Working knowledge of Python.
Basic understanding of databases.
Enthusiasm for learning automation, AI and cloud technologies.
Willingness to learn from senior developers and work in a team.
jobs.aboutCompany: HCLTech is a global technology company. This Campus Beginner role is aimed at fresh graduates who want to start a software development career with mentoring from experienced engineering teams.
